name: Benalup-Casas Viejas (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided green over red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Benalup-Casas Viejas (a bird and a tower on red).
history: Municipal flag of Benalup-Casas Viejas; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Benalup-Casas Viejas arms — bird and tower
